## Parental OpControl 0.17.11

- The small greeting above Luna now appears as a comic speech bubble next to the awake moon, with its tail pointing at Luna.
- The bubble has a soft paper look with a dark outline and a solid drop shadow in both the Night sky and Moon gray themes.
- It says "Hi, I'm Luna!" and "Got a question? I'm all ears!" in English, and "¡Hola, soy Luna!" and "¿Tienes una pregunta? ¡Te escucho!" in Spanish.
- The bubble sizes itself to the text, pops in when Luna wakes, and shrinks away when Luna sleeps or the chat opens. Clicking it opens the chat.
- Reduced motion uses a simple fade, and the bubble stays sharp from 100% to 200% display scaling.
- This release is offered to all devices through the normal catalog.
